verdict.rationale: The docs point to Justworks handling payroll tax mechanics. It collects employees' filing status, withholding and exemption details in place of W-4s. It also asks companies to verify payroll data each quarter, report outside payments before the quarterly adjustment deadline, supply prior payroll history under the company EIN, and record taxable fringe benefits, all of which implies Justworks prepares quarterly tax filings. However, no doc explicitly says it automatically calculates, files and remits taxes at the federal, state and local levels. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic tax filing and remittance, coverage of state and local jurisdictions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
